en: The postcard features a black and white photographic image of a tranquil landscaped park with a pond, benches, and various trees visible along the water's edge. The reverse side includes handwritten German text, an address, a green postage stamp from 'Deutsches Reich' depicting a profile of a man, and a cancellation mark reading 'BAD PYRMONT.' There is also a museum stamp mentioning 'BAD PYRMONT.'
